observed_invariants.clock_reset: native work requires the firmware-enabled modem clock/reset domain; interrupts require the domain to have been enabled in the current reset generation but may assert or remain latched while firmware subsequently gates its functional clock; a reset-generation change retires in-flight activity and enable history
observed_invariants.wifi_dma: TX descriptor and payload pointers are nonzero four-byte-aligned internal-memory addresses; payload length is 1 through 4095 bytes; descriptor word two may link a cycle-free chain of 2 through 64 hardware-owned MPDUs with EOF clear on intermediate nodes and set only on the terminal node, all of which must be QoS data with the same receiver, transmitter, TID and ACK policy and unique 12-bit sequences; normal-ACK policy inside a linked aggregate creates an implicit compressed-block-ACK response window, while explicit block-ACK policy is also accepted; the C6 internal wire word contributes a 12-bit hardware DMA length while its upper bits remain guest-LMAC-private state inspected by the pinned library and are not assigned invented hardware legality semantics; an aggregate is one RF/coexistence operation, one response window and one queue completion, while compressed BA origin/bitmap and successful-MPDU count are exact register-backed evidence and retry/resort/resubmit remain in guest LMAC; incoming aggregate input must have empty scalar bytes and the aggregate PHY, obey the same MPDU invariants, and consume exactly one native RX descriptor per MPDU; each firmware queue kick creates exactly one active hardware operation and exactly one status-nibble completion, with ACK, CTS or matching-TID block ACK selected from the transmitted MAC header and success, RF transmit error or response timeout selected by the observed outcome; descriptor RTS uses bit 31 of the descending protection register, is legal only for an individually addressed management or data MPDU with a response window, retains ownership across RTS/CTS and payload/ACK-or-BA phases, and reports recovered CTS-timeout status 2; fragment construction and retry remain in guest LMAC while every fragment receives an independent hardware ACK window; native RX interface matches come from valid firmware-programmed address slots, with SoftAP using slot one; an active RX block-ACK slot must use the firmware-observed enable/mode encoding and its peer, TID, 12-bit origin and 64-bit bitmap remain register-backed; every valid native crypto-table slot uses one of firmware-emitted control classes 3, 6, or 7 and reset zeroizes all ten slot words; the Protected Frame bit plus CCMP ExtIV/key ID selects exactly one valid peer/interface/key-ID/cipher tuple, while C6 descriptor upper bits remain guest-LMAC-private and carry no invented crypto meaning; missing, ambiguous, malformed, or unsupported hardware crypto selection is a hard error
observed_invariants.wifi_tsf_timers: the pinned HAL clears a stale timer event and enables its power-interrupt bit before enabling one of four TSF target comparators; it enables timer wakeup only while that comparator is enabled, and disables wakeup before disabling the comparator; raw, masked and write-one-to-clear event state must remain coherent
observed_invariants.wifi_rf: Wi-Fi airtime requires a firmware-strobed and locked supported RFPLL channel, calibration valid for the current modem-domain Wi-Fi reset generation, one complete firmware-observed transmit-gain table resolving to a supported quarter-dBm ceiling, supported 20 MHz bandwidth, and an explicitly released frontend; a MAC-only reset preserves this independently programmed RF state, and an armed RX DMA descriptor may remain idle while the frontend is forced off, while actual airtime with missing, partial, stale, forced-off, or unsupported state is a hard error
observed_invariants.bluetooth_le: native schedule records and security DMA must resolve through firmware-programmed internal-memory mappings before execution; connection-event sequence numbers, descriptor ownership and completion marks follow only genuine-firmware-observed transitions; the 100 kHz sleep timer accepts a future RTC compare followed by source-18 enable, permits firmware-observed armed cancellation, and permits pending clear only after expiry
observed_invariants.ieee802154: TX, RX, single-shot CCA, energy detection and ACK phases use the firmware command lifecycle and cannot overlap incompatibly; firmware must STOP an armed receiver before gating its APB/MAC clocks, while the observed STOP, clock-gate, wake and receive-rearm sequence is legal; malformed firmware transmit-security configuration is rejected through the observed hardware error path, while valid-FCS malformed secured receive bytes are ordinary guest-stack input and never a radio-legality violation
observed_invariants.coexistence: native Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE and IEEE 802.15.4 RF submissions execute only under a matching grant returned for their firmware-selected protocol and priority; firmware reset generations and clock/power gating cancel active ownership and its exact in-flight transmission; denial is an ordinary non-submission outcome reported to Wi-Fi LMAC as the recovered transmit-error status, while cross-protocol ownership is a hard error
